$comment: Curated Vancouver scene signals, used as positive evidence when a listing's
title gives the classifier nothing to work with.
A listing promoted by one of these, or held in one of these rooms, is
treated as in scope -- unless an exclusion term fires, so a film screening
at a club venue still gets dropped.
Add names as you find them. Matching is case-insensitive and substring
based against the promoter and venue fields, so 'vantek' catches
'notPromoters' is the inverse: promoters known to book other music. A
listing from one is dropped unless it confirms an in-scope genre outright.
